_comment: Facts established by hand that no reachable endpoint states.
Keys under 'courses' are parent course ids (a row's teachmeterial_ids[0]);
keys under 'books' are a row's own id. Values may set any of
stage/subject/version/grade/volume. These win over every derived source and
are reported as confirmed, not guessed - so only put things here you have
版本 for these two was read off the platform's own book page by the user,
2026-08-24; both are 英语 titles whose own record carries no publisher.

'publishers' maps the publisher name some PDF filenames end with onto the platform's 版本 tag. A plain string, or {'version': ..., 'source': 'confirmed'|'derived'}. 'derived' entries were narrowed by cross-referencing 学科 and are labelled as inferences; only set 'confirmed' for a value a human actually verified.
